title: default not destructive
rule: Highlight the common choice as default/primary, but do not assign default or primary to a destructive action (and do not default Yes on a confirmation).

citation.source: NN/g — OK-Cancel or Cancel-OK; Apple HIG — Buttons (don’t assign primary to destructive); NN/g — Confirmation Dialogs (§6 avoid default Yes)

pass_when: The common choice is default/primary; destructive is not default/primary; confirmation does not default Yes.
fail_when: Destructive or confirmation-Yes is the default/primary.
overview: The highlighted default is the common safe choice, never a destructive one.
apply_when: Choosing which button is primary on dialogs or confirmations.
not_when: Non-destructive flows where primary simply marks the main next step.
agent_hint: Make the common safe choice primary; never default destructive or Yes.
description: People often accept the highlighted default without fully reading. Put default or primary emphasis on the common safe choice, and never assign that emphasis to a destructive action. On confirmations, do not default Yes. This protects irreversible commits; it does not ban a filled primary on ordinary save or continue when the action is not destructive.
